pick.headline: Jimmy Carter crosses to North Korea in the nuclear crisis

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report East Asia 1994-06-15: Vol 94 Iss 115
evidence.snippet: …mbassador to Thailand, by NHK on 15 June; place not given— recorded; from the “NHK News 5” program] [Text] In an interview with NHK today, Yi To-sop, North Korean ambassador to Thailand, said a visit by former President Carter to North Korea would provide a good opportunity for North Korea to manifest its enthu- siasm for a settlement of the nuclear issue. [Begin Yi recording in English] I think that his visit will provide a good opportunity…
